g.text: Case interior, plan view: Peli 1450 with the 1450PF frame, the board set and the pack (design drawing of an unbuilt prototype)
Orange solid: cavity wall at the floor (Peli STEP); orange dashed: at the rim Z 108.97; orange dotted: flat floor to the R 15.88 fillet.

Brown dash-dot: 1450PF frame window; brown dotted: the frame skirt's inner face (M21d); brown thin: the frame's outer face at the skirt bottom (Z 86.00; 0.30 wider per side at its widest). Grey dashed: face plate C1 377.2 x 263.0 (chosen);
grey dotted: panel1450.py's plate 377.2 x 263.0 (as coded, superseded).

Brown solid: C6 setting legs (column; the dashed box is the foot on the flat floor). Black dots: the four M3 rods. Blue ticks: C2 arrestors at Z 59 on the RF entry plates; grey x: panel1450.py's wall jacks at Z 59 (as coded, superseded).

NOT SHOWN: parts on the boards (only board B's outline), cables and jumpers, the pack's hold-down (not designed, S-27), the lid and the QMX tray, the Xenarc and e-paper on the face, fasteners, and any tolerance band: CASE-MARGINS.md section

Board P's place at the block's south end is INFERRED (ASSEMBLY.md section 3, CASE-MARGINS.md M5); its hold-down and the block's are owed. Nominal geometry establishes no fit (CASE-MARGINS.md section 1).
Sources by sha256/16: CASE-MARGINS.md 0fc449b72532ba7c, frame_seat.py 959b9326f614f72a, frame_seat.out a65c0792a7a08c08, panel1450.py 3bdb88df98260244, pcb_board_facts.yaml 07af4d0f2b166694.

Every other input is in v2/docs/diagrams/case-drawings.md. Generated by v2/docs/diagrams/tools/case_drawings.py. Design drawing of an unbuilt prototype: nothing has been built, fitted to a case or measured.
